blocks.text: Sigalionidae have convoluted history. Histori- a taxonomic cally, the included scale-worms bearing compound group neurochaetae, corresponding largely to today’s Sigalioninae. Rouse and Fauchald’s (1997) cladistic analyses recovered Sigalionidae as the sister group to other Aphroditiformia that lacked compound neurochaetae. However, subsequent analyses based on both morphology (Pleijel and Dahlgren, 1998; Rouse and Pleijel, 2001) and also sequence data (Gonzalez et al., 2018a; Norlinder et al., 2012; Struck et al., 2005b; Wiklund et al., 2005; Zhang, Y. et al., 2018a) repeatedly revealed the paraphyly of Sigalionidae, both with regard to Pholoinae and Pisioninae.
